# Space HR

> AI HR chatbot and employee self-service platform that automates payroll, performance management, people analytics, and HR operations.

Space HR is an AI-powered HRMS and ERP platform for mid-market and enterprise teams. It pairs an AI HR Concierge chatbot with payroll anomaly detection, predictive workforce analytics, 360-degree appraisals, and multi-country tax compliance. Every AI search on Space HR is answered with verifiable source attribution, grounded by VeritasGraph — an open-source GraphRAG knowledge-graph framework that returns each result with a citation and reasoning path.
